model_metrics.target: outperform cross-sectional median over the horizon
model_metrics.note: Time-based holdout on a market-relative target. AUC near 0.50 means no edge -- treat it as such.

scorecard.note: Predictions need the full horizon in trading days to mature, and at least 5 symbols graded on the same date to form a cross-section. Check back after about a week of runs.

disclaimer: Educational tool. Not investment advice. Data from public free sources and may be delayed or wrong. Model probabilities carry a measured, small edge at best -- see holdout AUC. Every filing and disclosure shown is public information published by a regulator or an exchange; nothing here is or seeks material non-public information, which it is illegal to trade on.
